question: Does improved action MSE coexist with increased chunk-mean error in the existing paired CPU outputs?
primary_subset: Only samples with all first 16 action positions valid; no padding or one-frame terminal windows.
decomposition: For each sample and coordinate, MSE = squared mean error across 16 steps + mean squared deviation from that mean.
aggregation: Mean samples within each task, then mean tasks. Keep physical coordinates separate.
secondary: Nonoverlapping block-mean error power at block lengths 1,2,4,8,16.
limits: No fresh model calls, no training, no simulator, no new data transfer.
Single common-noise draw per observation; estimates include sampling noise.
Within-chunk error structure only, not error autocorrelation across deployed replanning cycles.
Chunk-mean joint-position error is not physical trajectory drift.
At most three selected tasks and nine episodes; coordinates are not independent trials.
